The Allison Inn and Spa places third in Pacific Northwest resort ranking

The Newberg resort ranks third in a 2026 Pacific Northwest list, according to The Oregonian’s headline.

By LokkeeVerse · 1 min read

The Allison Inn and Spa in Newberg, Oregon, ranks third in a 2026 ranking of Pacific Northwest resorts, according to the supplied headline from The Oregonian.

The accompanying description says the resort has received multiple honors in 2026, including the No. 1 hotel and resort ranking in Oregon from U.S. News & World Report. The supplied metadata does not identify the organization behind the Pacific Northwest ranking or explain its criteria.
